sourceTitle: Successful Exploration Through the Interior of Australia From Melbourne to the Gulf of Carpentaria
description: "Successful Exploration Through the Interior of Australia" by William John Wills is a historical account likely written in the mid-19th century. The work chronicles the journey and experiences of Wills during the Burke and Wills Exploring Expedition, outlining his role as second in command while navigating uncharted territories of Australia.
